name: cel-go-extension-usage-receipts-and-policy-3edb
instr:
cel-go cannot report which extension capabilities a checked CEL AST uses or enforce policy before exposing executable behavior. Add a portable, exact receipt and consistent admission policy, including after AST conversion or import. Without policy, preserve compilation, conversion, diagnostics, and synchronous evaluation.

Record every actual use across TwoVarComprehensions, Bindings, Lists, and Strings. Identify the exact macro, overload, or required internal operation from the configured library version and call semantics, including Strings locale, precision, and compile-time format validation. Include feature identity, configured version, expression, and source location. Order uses by source position and stable identity. Distinguish legacy binding from block planning. Exclude ordinary CEL constructs.

Public AST conversion helpers must preserve distinct uses through nested expansion and supported CheckedExpr conversions without changing established success, failure, source, or checked-state behavior. Return an independent, immutable-by-caller view. Evaluate policy in receipt order once checked usage is known. Associate the first denial with its source and preserve its wrapped cause. Unresolved uses produce neither receipts nor denials. Keep parse diagnostics unchanged. Combine applicable checker and policy diagnostics in deterministic source order.

Preserve inherited behavior and prevent child changes from affecting parents. During program planning, revalidate receipts fr
